definition: The practice or capability of generating functional source code directly from a natural language description of the desired behavior.
details: Prompt-to-code capabilities in modern LLMs have significantly changed software development workflows, enabling rapid prototyping and code generation directly from natural language task descriptions.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. Think of it this way: The practice or capability of generating functional source code directly from a natural language description of the desired behavior. And here is the clever part: Prompt-to-code capabilities in modern LLMs have significantly changed software development workflows, enabling rapid prototyping and code generation directly from natural language task descriptions. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. And that is Prompt-to-Code — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
